<!--
  Pick a delivery window: the days with their windows as radio chips, beside a card with the zone, its price and
  the buttons. Static markup. Axes: layout (split: the card beside the days, stacked: the days only), item
  (card, plain), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { SlotLabels } from "./slot-board.types";
import type { Day } from "../components/slot-grid.types";
import type { Zone } from "./zone-table.types";

export type SlotBoardProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  days: Day[];
  zone: Zone;
  labels: SlotLabels;
  layout?: "split" | "stacked";
  item?: "card" | "plain";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.vue";
import List from "../primitives/list/list.vue";
import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.vue";
import Select from "../primitives/select/select.vue";
import SelectOption from "../primitives/select/select-option.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Field from "../components/field.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import SlotGrid from "../components/slot-grid.vue";
import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  days,
  zone,
  labels,
  layout = "split",
  item = "card",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<SlotBoardProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :lead="lead" :tone="tone" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <Box class="grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-8 lg:grid-cols-3">
      <Box :class="(((layout as string) === 'split') ? 'lg:col-span-2' : 'lg:col-span-3')">
        <SlotGrid :days="days" :name="tpl('{0}-slot', id)" :item="item" />
      </Box>
      <Stack
        v-if="((layout as string) === 'split')"
        gap="4"
        align="stretch"
        class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6"
        data-testid="aside"
      >
        <Field :label="labels.zone" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-zone', id)">
          <Select :name="tpl('{0}-zone', id)" :id="tpl('{0}-zone', id)">
            <SelectOption :value="zone.id" :label="zone.name" :selected="true" />
          </Select>
        </Field>
        <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <ListItem class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
            <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ labels.price }}
            </Inline>
            <Inline class="font-medium">
              {{ fmtMoney(zone.price, zone.currency) }}
            </Inline>
          </ListItem>
          <ListItem class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
            <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ labels.freeFrom }}
            </Inline>
            <Inline class="font-medium">
              {{ fmtMoney(zone.freeFrom, zone.currency) }}
            </Inline>
          </ListItem>
          <ListItem class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
            <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ labels.time }}
            </Inline>
            <Inline class="font-medium">
              {{ zone.time }}
            </Inline>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
        <Button variant="default" size="default" class="w-full">
          {{ labels.primary }}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="outline" size="default" class="w-full">
          {{ labels.secondary }}
        </Button>
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ labels.note }}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    </Box>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
